title: The rigs we've created for chipsynth MD's emulation.
summary: A Plogue developer shows the custom electronic test rigs built to measure the Sega Mega Drive/Genesis sound chip (YM2612) for the chipsynth MD emulation. It covers the years of testing and reverse engineering needed to reproduce the chip's quirks accurately.
why: Recommended in threads on chip emulation as a look at how hard it is to emulate vintage sound hardware accurately.

quote.text: This video shows some insight into the development process
